sections.pricing_desc: Cost, margin analysis and price history
sections.profitability_desc: Margins, ROI and contribution to revenue
sections.restock_desc: Supplier info and lead time tracking

overview.what: A snapshot of the product's overall health: global score, margin, stock and turnover grouped together to spot at a glance what's healthy or needs action.
overview.tip: Always start with this overview. A global score below 50 or a stockout alert flags the product to prioritize.

pricing.what: Tracks selling price, buying price and margin rate, along with how they have evolved over time.
pricing.tip: Aim for a stable, positive margin. If the buying price rises without adjusting the selling price, update your pricing to protect the margin.

stock.what: Current stock level, recommended safety stock and stockout history to assess product availability.
stock.tip: Keep stock above the safety threshold. A high stockout rate means lost sales: trigger a restock before reaching that level.

sales.what: Measures how fast the product sells: turnover rate, daily sales velocity and demand trend.
sales.tip: High and rising turnover is healthy. Low turnover signals overstocking: reduce orders or launch a promotion.

profitability.what: The product's financial performance: ROI, total profit, average profit per sale and contribution to overall revenue.
profitability.tip: Focus on products with high ROI and high contribution. Low profit despite good volume may justify revisiting the price or supplier.

restock.what: Supply-chain analysis: restock frequency and cost, delivery lead times and reception rate.
restock.tip: Watch delivery lead times to calibrate safety stock. Long or irregular lead times require a larger stock buffer.

predictions.what: AI-generated forecasts: alert status, estimated stockout date, days of coverage and the optimal quantity to reorder.
predictions.tip: Place an order when stock reaches the suggested reorder point, using the optimal quantity to avoid both stockouts and overstock.

predictions_metrics.alert_status: Urgency level derived from current stock and sales pace: "OK" (comfortable stock), "Low stock" (below the reorder point) or "Stockout" (depleted or imminent).
predictions_metrics.days_coverage: Number of days the current stock covers demand at the average sales pace. Formula: current stock ÷ average daily sales.
predictions_metrics.stockout_date: Estimated date the stock runs out if the current sales pace holds. It equals today plus the days of coverage.
predictions_metrics.optimal_qty: Recommended quantity to order to rebuild an optimal stock (cover demand until the next delivery) without overstocking.
predictions_metrics.reorder_point: Trigger threshold: place an order as soon as stock drops to this level, so you are restocked before running out given the supplier lead time.

classification.what: The product's ranking: ABC class (importance) and popularity, profitability and reliability scores out of 100.
classification.tip: Prioritize class A products: they weigh the most in your business and deserve the closest monitoring.

comparative.what: How the product positions against its category and supplier: relative performance, rank and market share.
comparative.tip: A product well below its category average should be investigated: price, visibility or quality may be the cause.
